content.short: uMPC by GK8 uses patented technology to enable unlimited co-signers, delivering fast, secure signing.
content.description: uMPC leverages patented technology to enable an unlimited number of co-signers, delivering fast and secure signing for digital assets. Compared with most MPC solutions that handle up to seven signatures per second and rely on as few as three key shards, this approach has been tested with 30 shards and can reach up to 7,500 signatures per second. The protocol supports a broad set of networks, including Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Bitcoin, Celo, Cosmos, Ethereum, Fantom, Moonbeam, OP Mainnet, Solana, Aptos, and Polygon.
